alt: Testis (anatomy of the testis and epididymis) - labeled cross-section. Spermatic cord, cremaster muscle, tunica vaginalis + tunica albuginea, seminiferous tubule lobules, septa, head + body + tail of epididymis, ductus deferens, efferent ductules, rete testis, straight tubule (OpenStax A&P 2e, Figure 28.1.3).
